title: The when Expression

content.intro: In this lesson, you will learn **The when Expression** as part of **Decision-Making and Loops**. `if` and `when` can be expressions that produce a value; branches must cover the cases required by the expression’s type and context. Use the subtopics—Matching Individual Values, Multiple Conditions and Ranges, Exhaustive when Expressions—as a checklist: predict what the example will do, then verify it in a project configured for the target platform.
content.why_it_matters: Clear fundamentals help you reason about program behavior before adding abstraction. Small input/output checks make syntax and control flow easier to debug.
